limitation: This review separates responsibilities within one Codex agent. It is not an independent human or multi-person signoff. The user's instruction to complete the remaining M6 tasks authorizes only the deterministic M6.3 metadata-fixture implementation described here.

user_confirmation.confirmation_note: User explicitly stated: 继续，你直接完成M6剩余任务，需要我审批事项就发给我. This approval is bounded to deterministic CandidateBundle compilation from a supplied metadata snapshot; it does not authorize retrieval execution or evidence promotion.

checks: Candidate metadata is supplied as an immutable digest-bound snapshot, not obtained through a RAG, SQL, graph or network call.
The compiler binds request and selection-plan ids/digests and rejects a candidate route or source policy not selected by the plan.
Top-K seed, neighbor section and table context are separate candidate kinds, so contextual expansion cannot be mistaken for an exact numeric fact.
Candidate authority rank is filtered before deterministic metadata rank ordering.
Numeric requests require table context and relationship requests remain context-only.
Missing metadata or a required context kind becomes a typed retrieval exhaustion, never a synthetic substitute.
The input ToolSelectionPlan remains not_executed and no ToolInvocationReceipt is created.
The compiler performs no M5.4 admission, M5.5 reservation, tool, provider, network or database operation.
Candidate count is bounded by the exact EvidenceRequest candidate limit and top-K policy.
CandidateBundle retains only metadata references and coordinates; it does not parse a section/table, normalize a value or compute a numeric trace.
M6.5 remains the sole owner of ParserCandidate, NormalizedNumericFact and NumericProgramTrace.
Replay digest is stable for the same request, plan, policy and snapshot.
Wrong request-plan linkage, duplicate metadata id, source policy bypass and missing required expansion all fail closed.
No Evidence Gate, judgment, context injection, writer, business Case mutation or legacy authority change is admitted.

resolved_findings.finding: A raw candidate list could bypass the bounded ToolSelectionPlan and silently mix source routes.
resolved_findings.repair: Each metadata row must carry a selected route and exact request source policy; the compiler accepts only plan-selected routes.

resolved_findings.finding: Top-K output could lose the table or neighboring section needed to interpret an exact numeric row.
resolved_findings.repair: Policy names required candidate kinds by evidence role and reports typed retrieval exhaustion when a required kind is absent.

resolved_findings.finding: Metadata fixture construction could be misrepresented as a successful external retrieval.
resolved_findings.repair: Candidate snapshots are explicitly fixture_only and the result counters report zero retrieval, provider, external, model and store-write calls.

open_followups: M6.2 execution still requires a separately approved executor that performs M5.4/M5.5 checks in the real invocation transaction.
M6.3 full metadata-first RAG/DB recall, rerank and slot-level precision/recall calibration require an approved source corpus and a separate execution gate.
M6.4-M6.8 own repair, parsing, promotion, judgment and context contracts; a CandidateBundle is not promoted evidence.
